documented_probe: C-14f6efb2 (implement a multiple-instance-learning classifier forward pass): reference floor is medium and this covering task is exercised at medium with a fully specified MIL wiring (encoder -> attention gate -> bag classifier) checked on hidden bags including empty and single-instance edge cases.
notes: Agent wires an instance encoder, scalar attention gate and bag classifier in a fixed order under a fixed seed, plus a CLI that reports logits/attention/pred_class. Hidden cases vary in_dim/hidden/num_classes/seed and probe T=0 and T=1. Exact numeric equality is required against an in-container reference that follows the same deterministic construction, plus structural invariants (attention sums to 1, pred = argmax).
